title: Centralize audit check orchestration
summary: Centralized repeated Python-owned audit/check definitions behind a shared manifest and runner consumed by pre-commit, GitHub generated-context/deep-audit jobs, AI guardrail planning, and release self-test manifest loading.
reason: The same generated-context, guardrail, typing, change-packet, and related tooling checks were listed independently in pre-commit, GitHub workflows, AI guardrail code, and release self-test. A shared manifest reduces drift without moving runtime-specific runners into the wrong layer.
behavior_before: Pre-commit, phase1 drift CI, deep-audit CI, AI guardrail, and release self-test each maintained overlapping Python check lists by hand.
behavior_after: Python-owned check definitions live in mediapipeline.tools.dev.audit_checks. Runtime-specific surfaces call the shared suites while GitHub PR diff handling, PowerShell analysis, WebView/npm, Tauri, SARIF, CodeQL, Dependabot, and package build/verify runners remain separate.
